Period_or_Citation: Minn. Stat. § 147.081, subd. 1, as amended effective 2026-08-01
Atomic_Fact_or_Proposition: Non-natural persons may not practice medicine if the conduct fits subdivision 3.
Verification_Condition: No automatic civil damages count; classification and conduct must fit statutory text.

Atomic_Fact_or_Proposition: Theory: invasive extraction, screening, anticoagulant/saline administration, adverse-event response, laboratory review, and immunization evidence medical practice.
Verification_Condition: Defendants will argue federally regulated procurement is not diagnosis or treatment.

Atomic_Fact_or_Proposition: Eligibility and collection operate under responsible-physician supervision with permitted delegation.
Verification_Condition: Delegation to trained persons is expressly permitted; credential absence alone is not a per se federal violation.

Atomic_Fact_or_Proposition: Collection must not proceed when identified factors could adversely affect participant health; risk information and withdrawal opportunity are required.
Verification_Condition: Requires participant-specific records showing missed factors, inaccurate assessment, or inadequate risk information.

Atomic_Fact_or_Proposition: Initial and periodic informed consent must explain procedure risks and hazards.
Verification_Condition: Requires exact consent versions and dates; federal compliance may rebut state-law allegations.

Atomic_Fact_or_Proposition: Periodic testing and review are required; abnormal results can require deferral and physician review.
Verification_Condition: Requires actual laboratory results, review dates, notices, and reinstatement records.

Atomic_Fact_or_Proposition: Automated collections must be at least two days apart and no more than twice in seven days.
Verification_Condition: Alleged schedules may be within the maximum; the theory concerns inducement, individualized safety, and disclosure.

Atomic_Fact_or_Proposition: Source Plasma is collected for further manufacturing use.
Verification_Condition: Commercial purpose supports materiality but does not itself prove deception if adequately disclosed.

Atomic_Fact_or_Proposition: Selection, scheduling, administration, and response evaluation are physician-governed functions in approved programs.
Verification_Condition: Requires program approval, protocol, antigen records, purpose, and consent.

Atomic_Fact_or_Proposition: Paid Source Plasma for injectable manufacturing is subject to testing history and quarantine.
Verification_Condition: Supports commercial-product chain, not participant injury by itself.

Atomic_Fact_or_Proposition: Unauthorized access, request, or release can create direct liability.
Status_or_Weight: Direct action only on covered facts
Verification_Condition: No specific unauthorized access or disclosure is currently identified.

Atomic_Fact_or_Proposition: A regulatory violation may serve as an omitted fact only when disclosure duty, knowledge, materiality, causation, and injury are independently pleaded.
Verification_Condition: No categorical presumption eliminates controlling duty-to-disclose requirements.

Atomic_Fact_or_Proposition: Source Plasma participants are subject to health-history and physical-examination requirements.
Verification_Condition: Requires exact examination records and timing.
